sensors.guide: The crate must compile before the turn ends.
Clippy must pass with warnings as errors; fix the code rather than adding allow attributes.
Run cargo test before claiming done; fix the code, never the tests.
Respect the banned and allowed dependencies in deny.toml.
Reuse existing code instead of copying it.
Do not add crates with known vulnerabilities.
Tests must assert behaviour so that changing the code makes them fail.
